note.en: On-chip SRAM is 352 KiB (360448 bytes), following AC7926A Datasheet V1.5. The development board overview lists 256 KiB; this manifest uses the datasheet figure.
note.zh-CN: 片上 SRAM 为 352 KiB（360448 字节），按 AC7926A Datasheet V1.5 记载。开发板概述另列为 256 KiB；本 manifest 采用芯片手册数值。

note.en: count and pinout list the 84 regular GPIOs. The TuyaOpen WL83 TKL GPIO backend also accepts sparse USB GPIO codes 96/97 and 112/113; they are omitted from the regular pinout because available sources do not establish them as general board-header GPIOs.
note.zh-CN: count 和 pinout 列出 84 个常规 GPIO。TuyaOpen WL83 TKL GPIO 后端还接受稀疏 USB GPIO 编号 96/97、112/113；现有资料无法确认这些引脚可作为开发板普通扩展 GPIO，因此未列入常规引脚表。
